title: hm-learn-commands, version 1
description: One edit to an hm-learn-content draft (docs/formats/hm-learn-commands.md, learn-sdk ADR 0007, sdk-core ADR 0045). Every command's inverse is a command of this format. Texts, including every string and key inside a payload, are at most 2,000 Unicode code points, learn-sdk's default maxTextLength. Beyond this schema, the reducer checks each command against the draft it applies to: an exercise with the id exists, or doesn't when one is added; an added exercise's type is registered; a position is within the list; an addition stays within maxExercises; and a payload is nested at most 64 levels deep.

oneOf.description: Adds an exercise at a position, from 0 to the number of exercises.
Moves an exercise to a position among the others, from 0 to one less than the number of exercises.
Sets an exercise's title or instructions, or removes it with null.
Replaces an exercise's payload, as its type's editor builds it. The payload may be incomplete: the draft it makes may be invalid content until the teacher finishes.

text.description: A text of 1 to 2,000 Unicode code points (the default maxTextLength) with at least one character that isn't white space, as ECMAScript's String.prototype.trim defines it.

anyText.description: Any text of at most 2,000 Unicode code points, blank or not, as a draft's payload may hold.

position.description: A position in the list of exercises, from 0.

payload.description: An exercise's data: any JSON object, whose texts and keys are at most 2,000 code points.

json.description: Any JSON value, with texts and keys of at most 2,000 code points.

exercise.description: An exercise, as hm-learn-content holds it, with any object as its payload.
